central_config_note: Centralized config entry point is provider_catalog.central_config(): it lists, per supplier, the environment variable names that hold credentials/endpoints and whether each is set (boolean only). Credential values are never stored in this file and never returned by any helper.

config.notes: Keys are read from the environment only, never stored in this file (nano_banana.py).

providers.name: Gemini API
providers.notes: Per-image prices resolve through model_catalog.py against models.json; this file keeps no price copy.

comfyui.notes: Not a local ComfyUI deployment route for this supplier in hevi; use direct_api.

direct_api.notes: Official Gemini API REST, used by image.nano_banana_generate (nano_banana.py docstring).

providers.name: PixStag
providers.notes: Video pricing is per-second credits (720P = 1 credit/second, about $0.015/second per pixstag_client.py), not per-image: a per-image estimate for this supplier is always null with price_known=false.

comfyui.notes: Not a local ComfyUI deployment route for this supplier in hevi; use direct_api.

direct_api.notes: Default PIXSTAG_API_BASE in hevi/video/pixstag_client.py; v2 video API behind it.

runninghub.notes: Not a RunningHub deployment route for this supplier in hevi; use direct_api.

config.notes: Key from the environment only (multimodel.py); never stored in this file.

providers.name: Monid
providers.notes: No per-image price verified in hevi for this supplier: estimates are always null with price_known=false.

comfyui.notes: Not a local ComfyUI deployment route for this supplier in hevi; use direct_api.

direct_api.notes: Monid REST via MONID_API_KEY (multimodel.py). The base URL is not recorded in hevi's multimodel module, so it is null here rather than invented; configure it before use.

runninghub.notes: Not a RunningHub deployment route for this supplier in hevi; use direct_api.

routes_note: Every supplier carries the same three route identifiers: direct_api (supplier's own API), comfyui (local ComfyUI deployment route), runninghub (RunningHub deployment route). A route with supported=false is an explicit non-route for that supplier in hevi, not a missing field: callers must not assume a route exists because its key is present.
source: Clean-room supplier directory for hevi (Pixelle-Video idea only: a supplier catalogue with route options; no Pixelle-Video code, text, or structure is copied here). Supplier facts below come only from hevi's own modules: Gemini API ids and prices from model_catalog_data/models.json (nano_banana.py docstring), PixStag base URL and model names from hevi/video/pixstag_client.py, Monid route from hevi/capabilities/multimodel.py. Anything not verified in hevi is null with endpoint_verified=false, never invented.
source_note: Prices are NOT duplicated here: per-image USD prices live only in models.json and are resolved through model_catalog.py. A supplier whose pricing is not per-image (PixStag video credits) or not verified (Monid) reports estimated_cost_usd=null with price_known=false. DashScope is deliberately NOT listed: the account is in arrears and hevi has no verified supplier mapping for it, so no default route to it exists anywhere in this directory.
